checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: Instalar Python 3.12 e adicionar ao PATH.

test.name: Instalar Talude V1 + testes
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

build.name: Instalar dependências
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

build.name: Criar pacote local
build.command: $out='builds/latest'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; if (Test-Path ($out + '/Talude_V1_Source.zip')) { Remove-Item ($out + '/Talude_V1_Source.zip') -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path src,config,scripts,README.md,pyproject.toml -DestinationPath ($out + '/Talude_V1_Source.zip') -Force; Write-Output ('ZIP: ' + (Resolve-Path ($out + '/Talude_V1_Source.zip')))
